svg.title: Diffusion forward marginals and reverse direction
svg.desc: Analytic one-dimensional equal mixture of Gaussians with means -2 and 2 and standard deviation 0.4, evolving under alpha(t)=exp(-3t) and sigma(t)=sqrt(1-alpha(t)^2). Three panels show t=0, 0.2, and 1. The dashed terminal curve is N(0,1); the terminal marginal is only approximately Gaussian. Reverse SDE and probability-flow ODE have the same marginals under the exact score and matching initialization.
